mappings.boundary: molecular identity is retained in polymorphism; semantic identity is not inferred across meme variants
a participant is never a process condition, host, vector, or substrate
mappings.memetic_shape: named channel, network, ranking, audience, and observation context

mappings.boundary: no physical conversion, infection, adoption, semantic equivalence, inverse, or transitive route transfers
mappings.memetic_shape: a witnessed or explicitly authored copy, remix, translation, or reintroduction relation
mappings.polymorph_shape: a witnessed production or conversion route

mappings.boundary: popularity is not thermodynamic stability, truth, value, health, or worth
mappings.memetic_shape: bounded observation or reproduction of a variant in a named context
mappings.polymorph_shape: routine access to a form under named conditions

mappings.boundary: reappearance does not prove a shared mechanism, original cause, preserved meaning, or inevitable recurrence
mappings.memetic_shape: a variant observed or reproduced again in a changed context
mappings.polymorph_shape: a prior form reached again through changed material conditions
